reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String sectionFlattening(String s){if(s.isEmpty())return null;var d=new TreeMap<String,String>();for(String r:s.split(",",-1)){String[]p=r.split("=",2),q=p[0].split(":",-1);if(p.length!=2||q.length!=2||!q[0].matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*")||!q[1].matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*")||p[1].isEmpty())return null;for(char c:p[1].toCharArray())if(c<32||c>126||c==',')return null;String id=q[0]+"."+q[1];if(d.putIfAbsent(id,p[1])!=null)return null;}return d.entrySet().stream().map(e->e.getKey()+"="+e.getValue()).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.joining(","));}}
